description:
Cast Touch the Spirit Realm by paying {2}{W}.
When Touch the Spirit Realm enters the battlefield, it triggers, exiling Abdel Adrian until Touch the Spirit Realm leaves the battlefield.
Abdel Adrian leaves the battlefield, ending its effect, causing Oblivion Ring to return from exile to the battlefield.
When Oblivion Ring enters the battlefield, its first ability triggers, exiling Touch the Spirit Realm.
Touch the Spirit Realm leaves the battlefield, ending its effect, causing Abdel Adrian to return from exile to the battlefield.
When Abdel Adrian enters the battlefield, it triggers, exiling Oblivion Ring and any number of other nonland permanents you control until Abdel Adrian leaves the battlefield and creating at least one 1/1 Soldier creature token.
When Oblivion Ring leaves the battlefield, its second ability triggers, returning Touch the Spirit Realm to the battlefield from exile.
Repeat from step 2.
